summary.intent: Fix the friction tab in the agent skill improvement TUI, which was always showing empty despite friction data existing in the database.
summary.outcome: Two root causes were identified and fixed: (1) plugin-based skills (Superpowers, Codex, etc.) were never discovered by DiscoverSkills, so their friction data had no skill to attach to; (2) the transcript-based session attribution path in PopulateFromInsightsDB never carried friction data from insightsdb into skilldb. Both fixes landed with tests, and the friction tab now shows populated data.

repo: DiscoverSkills only scanned .claude/skills/ and .claude/commands/ — it was blind to plugin-based skills in ~/.claude/plugins/cache/{org}/{plugin}/{version}/

PopulateFromInsightsDB runs in two steps: Step 1 fetches skill_signals (has friction, fails on name resolution), Step 2 attributes sessions via transcript matching (resolves names, but never looked at friction). The mismatch caused a silent data loss.

ResolveSkillName handles plugin prefixes like superpowers:brainstorming and codex:review by matching on the last segment, so once plugins were discovered, name resolution worked without additional changes.
cacheVersion must be bumped whenever discovery logic or population logic changes, to force re-population for existing users.
The pre-existing TestDiscoverSkills_YAMLNameExtraction test is environment-sensitive — it picks up personal skills from ~/.claude/ and fails on developer machines with installed skills.
The permissions package has 12 pre-existing lint errors unrelated to skilldb changes.

code.finding: signalsBySession lookup map built from already-fetched skill_signals allows Step 2 (transcript attribution) to carry friction and missing instructions without any additional DB queries.

Added ScopePlugin constant and discoverPluginSkills function. Plugin cache layout is ~/.claude/plugins/cache/{org}/{plugin}/{version}/ with skills/, commands/, and agent-defs/ subdirectories. Latest version is selected by sorting version dirs.

New tests TestPopulateFromInsightsDB_TranscriptFallbackCarriesFriction and TestPopulateFromInsightsDB_TranscriptFallbackMultipleFrictionItems cover the session attribution + friction carry-over path with mismatched LLM skill names.

workflow: When a bug involves a data pipeline, trace each stage independently in the DB before reading code — the SQL queries revealed the disconnect (29 friction rows in insightsdb, 0 in skilldb) immediately.
goconst lint rule flags string literals used 3+ times; extracting constants (outcomeSuccess, outcomeFriction) is required to pass lint.
unparam lint flags functions that always return nil error — simplify signatures to remove the error return to fix cleanly.
Verify pre-existing lint/test failures on main before attributing them to your changes to avoid wasted debugging.

friction: improve --dry-run does not trigger skill TUI repopulation, requiring a manual test program to verify end-to-end behavior after cache clear.

Multiple rounds of lint fixes needed: goconst (string literals), nilerr (nil return after error check), unparam (always-nil error returns), wrapcheck (unwrapped os.ReadDir error) — each requiring a separate read-edit-lint cycle.
The skills showing up as empty (second user complaint) turned out to be a separate transient issue unrelated to the friction fix — root cause was not fully diagnosed in the transcript.
Cache version must be manually tracked and bumped; no automated mechanism to detect when a bump is needed.
open_items: TestDiscoverSkills_YAMLNameExtraction is environment-sensitive and fails on machines with personal skills installed — needs a mock or isolated test environment.
Plugin skill discovery uses latest version dir by sorting, but no test coverage for multi-version plugin cache layout.
The skilltui picker only has Repo/Personal filter scopes — plugin skills appear under All but there is no Plugin filter tab for discoverability.
permissions package has 12 pre-existing lint errors that were not addressed.
